method: Compared all named command headings in clauses 6, 7 and 11.1 with the Tcl registration table, option validation, UPF IR verifiers, simulation lowering, injected SV package and clause/driver/IR tests. A registered command is not treated as complete support. Accepted options may still be rejected during elaboration; limits are listed separately. This inventory is not a full conformance certification.
constraints: Keep runtime slim; add runtime functions only with demonstrated simulation speed benefit.
Prefer compiler-time semantic resolution and existing MLIR operations; introduce typed UPF operations when they simplify optimization.
Reuse existing LLVM/MLIR, Z3, Slang and Tcl dependency artifacts.

tcl_commands.limits: Explicit module-instance selections, deferred and empty extents, additive transactional updates, aggregate exclusions and globally resolved nested/donut ownership. Explicit descendant re-entry survives ancestor exclusions; inheritance stops at another domain boundary. Existing handle identities, bindings, catalogs and strategies survive updates. Empty effective extents avoid corruption/snapshot machinery but retain physical switching and explicit state catalogs. Composite/atomic domains, hard-macro model selections, available/boundary supplies and PG function-type definitions remain unsupported. Per-path isolation across lower or multiple boundaries is still rejected.

tcl_commands.limits: Module/generate hierarchy queries include instances, model-name matching, logic ports, HDL nets/variables and named processes; UPF-created supply ports have execution-time visibility and direction filters. Tcl glob brace alternatives, regexp/exact/case modes, escaped identifier/array identity and static packed/unpacked/enum selections are supported. Macro/leaf filters and traversal await design attributes; implemented HDL supply objects/ports await linkage. Patterns are bounded to 64 KiB without NUL, brace expansion to 4096 alternatives/4 MiB/256 levels/65536 work steps, and selected-element enumeration to 1048576 work units. Broad regexp bit queries can reach that limit; conservative anchored-prefix pruning avoids unrelated arrays when provable.

chunks.review: Independent subagent reviewed IEEE 1801-2018 5.11/6.31, relevant LRM identifier rules, Tcl ownership/error semantics, LLVM/MLIR practice and test coverage. Unicode character counting and Tcl object-based regexp execution corrected during review.
chunks.validation: Worktree-built compiler: new query-mode test and existing database/error tests pass (3 lit tests).

chunks.scope: supply_partial_on through existing supply access lowering
chunks.validation: 198 unique UPF-related lit tests pass, including 14 UPF dialect tests (the separate 14-test run overlaps the case-insensitive lit filter). Official IEEE1801 probes 6.31, 6.47 and 11.2.3.3.4-.6 pass in native and bytecode tiers (10 cases). Wasm32 native/bytecode object compilation also passes; wasm execution was not run.
chunks.review: Independent subagent approved UPF 11.2.3.3.6/6.47/9.2.3, LRM conversion/scheduling semantics, MLIR types/effects, guarded conversion and atomic storage publication; independently executed direct lowering, CSE/effect and publication barrier tests.

chunks.scope: Remaining find_objects globbing, object kinds and direction filtering; macro/leaf semantics depend on attribute support.

completed.review: Independent subagent reviewed the UPF/LRM requirements, Tcl ownership and error recovery, semantic name keys, escaped instance arrays, enums, variables, generate creation-scope overrides, conservative regexp pruning and test coverage. All reported semantic failures were corrected and independently reproduced as passing before approval.
completed.validation: Six targeted lit tests pass, including native/bytecode query-created intent and emitted IR bit offsets. Full case-insensitive UPF/simulation-supply regression selection passes all 201 unique tests. Eight IEEE1801 clauses pass in native and bytecode tiers (16 cases).

completed.review: Independent subagent approved UPF/LRM rules, transactional updates, handle identity, namespace checks, switch propagation, retained state-catalog diagnostics, MLIR control flow/effects and coverage. Review found empty balloon intent unnecessarily enabled snapshot machinery and rejected context DPI; fixed with positive and negative extent tests before approval.
completed.validation: 11 targeted lit tests and all 208 unique UPF/simulation-supply regression tests pass. Eight IEEE1801 clauses across native/bytecode produce 12 passes, two reference-only cases and two expected failures; no unexpected results. Emitted IR tests verify empty domains avoid corruption epochs/guards and unnecessary retention snapshots.

completed.scope: Transactional aggregate exclusions and compiler-only global parent-ownership resolution, including nested/donut domains, explicit re-entry, typed canonical extent attributes and shared membership across guards/corruption/retention
completed.review: Independent subagent reviewed IEEE1801 ownership/precedence/effective-element-list rules and LRM hierarchy/scheduling, MLIR attributes/pass behavior, shared membership and test coverage. Parent inheritance instead of ancestor fallback, preserved raw aggregate provenance, resolved emptiness, no-UPF analysis preservation and nested module scope were checked; review findings fixed before approval.
completed.validation: 14 targeted lit tests pass. All 216 unique UPF/simulation-supply regression tests pass, including four older declaration-only fixtures corrected to avoid unrelated duplicate domain ownership. Ten selected IEEE1801 clauses produce 18 native/bytecode passes and two reference-only cases; 5.7.2 and 5.9 promoted from XFAIL to SINCE 0.2.0.
